==Details==
{{Quest details
|start = Talk to [[Sir Amik Varze]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=2}} of the [[White Knights' Castle]]'s western tower in [[Falador]].
|startmap = 2959,3336,plane:2
|difficulty = Intermediate
|description = The Black Knights are up to no good. You are hired by the white knights to spy on them and destroy their secret weapon.
|length = Very Short
|requirements = * {{SCP|Quest|12}} [[Quest points]] {{Questreqstart|yes}}
* The ability to evade level 33 [[Black Knight]]s
|items = * [[Cabbage]] (can be obtained from the cabbage patch in [[Edgeville Monastery]] and [[South Falador Farm]], as well as [[Lumbridge Castle#Cellar|Lumbridge cellar]]. Cabbages obtained from [[Draynor Manor]] '''CANNOT''' be used)
* [[Iron chainbody]] (can be purchased at [[Horvik's Armour Shop]] in [[Varrock]] and from [[Wayne's Chains - Chainmail Specialist|Wayne's Chains]] in [[Falador]])
* [[Bronze med helm]] (can be purchased in the helmet shop in [[Barbarian Village]], spawns by the backdoor of [[Draynor Manor]])
|recommended = * {{SCP|Combat|15|link=yes}}
* [[Food]]
* [[Armour]]
* [[Falador teleport]]s
* ''([[Members]] only)'' [[Combat bracelet]] to the [[Edgeville Monastery|Monastery]] and head west towards the [[Black Knights' Fortress (location)|Black Knights' Fortress]]
|kills = None
|leagueRegion = <poem>
